version.text: Added six new original wallpapers with offline previews
Improved the home screen with direct gallery, download, and request actions
Made wallpaper previews shareable and verified saving and application
Clarified what the icon request reads and when data is sent
Removed unused billing and license-check permissions
Fixed release signing verification for current Android build tools
Included the new adaptive, themed, and legacy launcher artwork
Replaced the launcher icon with new adaptive and themed artwork
Polished the icon gallery and request dashboard states
Improved mobile layout, keyboard focus, and light/dark web surfaces
Refined launcher apply recovery messages and dashboard home-card copy
Added a privacy policy target for the request consent dialog
Added local preview regression checks for common launcher masks
Added local sharp, line, and filled themed-icon style prototypes
Added coverage-gap, provenance, and dependency advisory release gates
Fixed issue-template contact links for repositories without Discussions
Expanded every iOS era to 57 icons
Added per-era variants for popular third-party and Google apps
Replaced bitmap monochrome stubs with vector themed-icon layers
Added era-specific Material You tint resources for themed icons
Added explicit no-backup and no-device-transfer policy rules
Improved era switching for third-party icons
Synced dashboard filters and gallery output with the expanded catalog
Initial release
20 icons per iOS generation (14, 15, 16, 17, 18)
10 iOS 26 Liquid Glass icons
110 total icons across 6 iOS eras
Supports 30+ Android launchers
